fact: At 30 May 2026 the DGI taxpayer register held 203,723 taxpayers, 76,993 not yet on the new NIF format, with 111,951 taxpayers managed by centres not yet connected to SAFIG 2 and two further files kept manually.
title: Rapport d'assistance technique : Consolidation de l'intégrité du répertoire des contribuables
publisher: Fonds monétaire international, AFRITAC de l'Ouest
